# Project Memory & Instructions

## User Preferences

### Work Style
- **Work in smaller parts**: Always break large tasks into smaller chunks to avoid length limits
- **Notebooks**: Create notebooks in incremental sections (Part 1, Part 2, etc.) when content is extensive
- **Max cells per creation**: Limit to 10-15 cells at a time, then continue
- **Confirm before proceeding**: After each part, briefly confirm completion before continuing
